# truenas_ssh_connection (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an existing TrueNAS ssh connection.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Retrieve information about an existing SSH connection
data "truenas_ssh_connection" "connection" {
  name = "connection"
}

output "ssh_connection_id" {
  value = data.truenas_ssh_connection.connection.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the SSH connection to look up.

### Read-Only

- `connect_timeout` (Number) Time (in seconds) before the system stops attempting to establish a connection with the remote system.
- `host` (String) Hostname or IP address of the remote system.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the SSH connection.
- `port` (Number) Port number to connect to on the remote system
- `private_key_id` (Number) ID of the SSH keypair to authenticate with the remote host.
- `remote_host_key` (String) Remote system SSH key for this system to authenticate the connection.
- `username` (String) Username on the remote system which will be used to login via SSH.
